z-m-05-05.title: Imisa gololoo ayaa ku jira looxa gololooyinka?
z-m-05-05.topic: Tirinta adigoo isticmaalaya ku dhufasho iyo hubin
z-m-05-05.goal: Isbarbar dhig saddex hab oo tirin ah, go'aami habka kee sax yahay shuruudo kee hoostooda, oo qor sababta aan jawaab ugu hubino hab kale.
z-m-05-05.material:
Looxa gololooyinka wuxuu leeyahay 5 saf oo godad ah, saf kasta wuxuu leeyahay 6 god (30 god wadar ahaan). Laakiin gololooyinku ma jiraan god kasta, waxaana jira 3 god oo madhan. Tirooyinka gololooyinka safafka 1 ilaa 5, nidaam ahaan, waa 6, 6, 5, 5, 5. Saddex saaxiib ayaa helay tirada gololooyinka.
Gaon: "5×6=30, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 30 gololoo."
Narae: "Waxaa jira 30 god iyo 3 god oo madhan, sidaas darteed 30 laga jaray 3 waa 27 gololoo."
Daon: "Waxaan tiriyey gololooyinka saf kasta oo isku daray. 6+6+5+5+5=27 gololoo."
z-m-05-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan hababka sheegaya imisa gololoo ayaa jira wadar ahaan.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.hint.0: Haddii ay jiraan 3 god oo madhan, ka fikir haddii tirada gololooyinku ka badan tahay mise ka yar tahay tirada godadka.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hel farqiga u dhexeeya wadarta gololooyinka saf kasta iyo tirada godadka, 30, oo la barbar dhig tirada godadka madhan.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.r.a: Kani waa habka toos u tirinta gololooyinka saf kasta iyo isku darka.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.r.b: 5×6 waa tirada godadka. Waxay la mid tahay tirada gololooyinka kaliya haddii god kasta uu leeyahay hal gololoo. Looxani wuxuu leeyahay godad madhan.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.r.c: Kani waa habka ka jarista tirada godadka madhan tirada godadka si loo helo tirada gololooyinka.
z-m-05-05.s.s1.explain: Narae ayaa ka jaray 3-da god ee madhan 30 godad oo helay 27, Daon-na ayaa tiriyey saf saf oo isku daray si loo helo 27. 30 ee Gaon waa qiimaha malaynaya gololoo ayaa jira god kasta.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.prompt: Maxaad marka hore u baahan tahay inaad hubiso si aad u hesho tirada gololooyinka habka Gaon?
z-m-05-05.s.s2.hint.0: Hal weedh ku qor waxa 5×6 tirinayo.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sawir hal saf oo looxa gololooyinka ah oo eeg sida hal god iyo hal gololoo loo lammaaneeyo.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.o.a: Haddii gololooyinka oo dhan ay isku midab yihiin
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.a: Midabku xiriir la'aan wuxuu la leeyahay tirinta gololooyinka.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.b: Qaab kasta ha ahaadee, tirada gololooyinku waxay ku xiran tahay haddii god kasta uu leeyahay gololoo.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.o.c: Safka kee ayaa leh gololooyinka ugu badan
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.c: Haddii safafku leeyihiin isla tiro ama tiro kala duwan waxay saameysaa sida ku dhufashada loo isticmaalo, laakiin waa inaad marka hore eegtaa haddii godad madhan ay jiraan.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.o.d: Haddii god kasta uu leeyahay hal gololoo
z-m-05-05.s.s2.r.d: Wax-ku-dhufashadu waa tirada godadka, sidaas darteed furaha waa haddii god kasta uu leeyahay gololoo.
z-m-05-05.s.s2.explain: 5×6=30 waa tirada godadka. Haddii hal gololoo uu jiro god kasta, waxaa sidoo kale jira 30 gololoo. Haddii godad madhan ay jiraan, waxaa jira intaas ka yar.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.prompt: Dooro habka Narae ama habka Daon, qor habka lagu helo tirada gololooyinka, oo sidoo kale qor sida loo hubiyo haddii jawaabtu sax tahay adigoo isticmaalaya habka saaxiibka kale.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.hint.0: Garab garab u qor natiijooyinka labada hab.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.hint.1: Hal weedh ku qor waxa ammaan ah haddii labada qiime isku mid yihiin.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Xisaabinta habka aad doortay ma la mid tahay tirada dhabta ah ee gololooyinka, 27?
z-m-05-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Marka aad ku hubinayso hab kale, ma sheegtay inaad isbarbar dhigto labada qiime?
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.0: Habka Narae waxa uu ka jaraa 3-da god ee madhan 30-ka god. Haddii aad tirisid gololooyinka saf kasta oo aad isku darto, sida Daon, sidoo kale waxaad heleysaa 27, sidaas darteed midba midka kale wuu xaqiijiyaa.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.1: Waxaan helay 6+6+5+5+5=27 habka Daon. Haddii aan ka jaro 3-da god ee madhan 30-ka god, waa 27, sidaas darteed waan hubin karaa in isla qiime ay soo baxdo.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.2: Habka Daon: 6+6+5+5+5=27. Habka Narae 30-3=27, taasoo isku mid ah, sidaas darteed waa jawaabta saxda ah.
z-m-05-05.s.s3.model.3: Narae: 30 god laga jaray 3 god oo madhan waa 27. Tirinta saf kasta iyo isku darka sida Daon sidoo kale waxay bixisaa 27, sidaas darteed way isku waafaqaan.

z-m-05-06.title: Ku dhufashadu ma had iyo jeer ayay tirada ka weyneysaa waxay ahayd?
z-m-05-06.goal: Tijaabi bayaanka 'ku dhufashadu waxay tirada ka weyneysaa asalka' adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaal lid ku ah, oo sheeg ku dhufayaasha kee ayuu run yahay.
z-m-05-06.material: Doyun ayaa yidhi, "Haddii aad tiro ku dhufato tiro kale, had iyo jeer way ka weyn tahay tirada asalka ah!" Halkan tirada asalka ah a waa tiro laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 9, ku dhufaha b-na waa tiro laga bilaabo 0 ilaa 9. Hel wax-ku-dhufashada adigoo isticmaalaya xaqiiqooyinka ku dhufashada.
z-m-05-06.thinking.0: Samee tusaalayaal lid ku ah guud-ka-dhigid
z-m-05-06.thinking.1: Hel shuruudaha ay run ku tahay
z-m-05-06.thinking.2: Sharax adigoo ku xiraya tusaalayaal iyo sababo
z-m-05-06.prereq.0: Ogaanshaha xaqiiqooyinka ku dhufashada iyo wax-ku-dhufashooyinka 0 iyo 1 (Fasalka 2)
z-m-05-06.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay hab fiican oo lagu hubiyo bayaanka Doyun?
z-m-05-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ka bilow tijaabinta marka ku dhufuhu yahay tirada ugu yar.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kor u qaad ku dhufaha hal hal laga bilaabo 0 oo shax ku qor sida wax-ku-dhufashadu u beddelmo.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.a: Beddel ku dhufaha oo raadi wax-ku-dhufashooyin aan weynaan
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.a: Kani waa hab lagu ogaado in erayga 'had iyo jeer' lagu jebin karo xitaa hal tusaale, oo lagu raadiyo kiisaska u badan inay jebiyaan.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.b: 3×2, 4×5, iyo 6×3 dhammaantood way weyneadeen, sidaas darteed bayaanku waa sax
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.b: Inkastoo saddexda tusaale dhammaantood weynaadeen, waxaad tijaabisay kaliya kiisaska ku dhufuhu yahay 2 ama ka badan. Isku day ku dhufayaal kale sidoo kale.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.c: Ku dhufashadu waxay keentaa koritaan, sidaas darteed waa sax tijaabo la'aan
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.c: Dareenka ah ku dhufashadu waxay keentaa koritaan waa malayn, maaha xeer. Ma ogaan kartid ka hor intaadan tijaabin.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.o.d: Dooro oo keliya meelaha shaxda ku dhufashada ee ku dhufuhu weyn yahay
z-m-05-06.s.s1.r.d: Haddii aad doorato oo keliya tirooyin waaweyn, ma arki kartid kiisaska bayaanku jabi karo. Marka hore ka fikir ku dhufashada tirooyin noocee ah ayaa jebin kara bayaanka.
z-m-05-06.s.s1.explain: Si loo hubiyo 'had iyo jeer way weynaataa,' habka ugu toosan waa in la helo oo la tijaabiyo kiisaska laga yaabo inaanay weynaan. Tijaabinta noocyo kala duwan oo ku dhufayaal ah ayaa ka muhiimsan uruurinta tusaalayaal badan oo dhinac keliya ah.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.prompt: Samee 3 tusaale oo kala duwan oo bayaanka Doyun aanu run ahayn. (Wax-ku-dhufashadu waa inaysan ka weyn tirada asalka ah a. Wax-ku-dhufasho la mid tirada asalka ah sidoo kale waxaa loo tiriyaa 'ma weyn'.)
z-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.0: Hel wax-soo-saarrada marka isku-dhufaha yahay 0 iyo marka uu yahay 1.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tijaabi haddii isla wax dhacaan marka aad beddesho tirada asalka ah.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.2: Wax-soo-saar la simanyahay tirada asalka ah sidoo kale waxaa ku jira 'ma weynaan.'
z-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Tirada asalka ahi waa tiro laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Tirada asalka ahi waa inay noqotaa tiro dabiici ah laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Isku-dhufaha waa tiro laga bilaabo 0 ilaa 9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Isku-dhufaha waa inuu noqdaa tiro laga bilaabo 0 ilaa 9.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Wax-soo-saarka kama weynaan tirada asalka ah.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Wax-soo-saarka ayaa ka weynaaday tirada asalka ah.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.explain: Haddii isku-dhufaha yahay 0, wax-soo-saarku waa 0, sidaa darteed wuu yaraadaa, haddii uu yahay 1 na, wax-soo-saarku wuxuu la mid yahay tirada asalka ah, sidaa darteed ma weynaado. Haddii isku-dhufaha yahay 2 ama ka badan, wax-soo-saarku wuu weynaadaa marka tirada asalka ah tahay 1 ama ka badan.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.prompt: U sharax Doyun, adigoo tusaalayaal isticmaalaya, tirooyinka kee ku dhufashadu ka dhigto hadalkiisa mid aan run ahayn.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Dooro laba ka mid ah tusaalayaashaada oo dhinac dhinac u qor wax-soo-saarka iyo tirada asalka ah.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig waxa isku-dhufuhu yahay labada tusaale.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Tusaalayaashaada, ma si toos ah ayaad u isbarbar dhigtay wax-soo-saarka iyo tirada asalka ah?
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma kala saartay in natiijooyinka 0 iyo 1 ay kala duwan yihiin?
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Haddii aad ku dhufato 0, 5×0=0, sidaa darteed way ka yaraan tahay tirada asalka ah. Haddii aad ku dhufato 1, 5×1=5, sidaa darteed waxay ku sii jirtaa isku mid. Sidaa darteed hadalka 'had iyo jeer way weynaataa' waa khalad.
z-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Haddii isku-dhufuhu yahay 1, 7×1=7 wuxuu la mid yahay tirada asalka ah, sidaa darteed ma weynaado. Haddii uu yahay 0, wuxuu noqdaa 0 oo wuu yaraadaa.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.prompt: Marka tirada asalka ahi tahay tiro laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 9, tiro noocee ah ayaa isku-dhufuhu noqon doonaa si wax-soo-saarku had iyo jeer uga weynaado tirada asalka ah?
z-m-05-06.s.s3.hint.0: Hel wax-soo-saarrada marka isku-dhufuhu yahay 1, 2, iyo 3, oo mid walba la barbar dhig tirada asalka ah.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.hint.1: Tirada asalka ah ka dhig 4 oo isticmaal isku-dhufayaasha 0 ilaa 5 si aad u aragto sida wax-soo-saarku u beddelmo.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.a: Haddii aad ku dhufato 1, wax-soo-saarku wuxuu la mid yahay tirada asalka ah. In la mid yahay ma aha 'weynaan.'
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.b: Tirooyinka aan ahayn 0 waxaa ku jira 1. Hubi waxa dhaca marka aad ku dhufato 1.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.c: Haddii isku-dhufuhu yahay 2 ama ka badan, wax-soo-saarku wuu ka weyn yahay ama wuu la simanyahay tirada asalka ah oo lagu daray tirada asalka ah, sidaa darteed had iyo jeer wuu weynaadaa.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.r.d: Ku dhufashada 3 sidoo kale way weynaysaa. Waxaa jira tirooyin kale marka laga reebo tirooyinka laba-laba ah.
z-m-05-06.s.s3.explain: Haddii isku-dhufuhu yahay 2 ama ka badan, wax-soo-saarku wuxuu ugu yaraan yahay 2 jeer tirada asalka ah, sidaa darteed marka tirada asalka ahi tahay 1 ama ka badan, had iyo jeer wuu ka weyn yahay tirada asalka ah. Tirooyinka aan laba-laba ahayn, sida 3, sidoo kale waa ku jiraan.

z-m-05-01.title: Lambar noocee ah ayaad helaysaa marka laba lambar oo ay dhiman yihiin ay kulmaan?
z-m-05-01.goal: Uruuri tusaalayaal si aad u qiyaasto nooca lambar ee wadarta kaararka dhiman ay tahay, dib u eeg inta aad rumaysan tahay qiyaastaada ka dib dhegaysiga sharaxaad lammaaneyn ah, oo isticmaal tusaale lid ku ah si aad u muujiso in hadalka rogan uusan sax ahayn.
z-m-05-01.material: Seoa iyo Hajun waxay ciyaaraan ciyaar kaararka lambarrada (lambarrada 1 ilaa 30). Lambar labood waa lambar aan wax ka hadhin marka loo kooxeeyo laba laba (2, 4, 6, ...), lambar dhiman-na waa lambar hal ka hadhaya marka loo kooxeeyo laba laba (1, 3, 5, ...). Ciyaarta, 'wadarta' waa qiimaha aad hesho marka aad ku darto dhammaan lambarrada kaararka ku qoran.

z-m-05-01.thinking.1: Dib u eeg go'aankaaga ka dib helitaanka tusaalayaal cusub iyo sharaxaad
z-m-05-01.thinking.2: Adigu samee tusaale lid ku ah hadalka rogan
z-m-05-01.prereq.0: Ogow in lambar labood aanu waxba ka hadhin marka laba laba loo kooxeeyo iyo in lambar dhiman uu hal ka hadho (Fasalka 2aad)

z-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kala sooc wadarrada tusaalayaasha labood iyo dhiman, oo ku habee jadwal.
z-m-05-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sawir 3 iyo 5 sidii dhibco oo lammaaneey adigu, adoo raacaya sharaxaadda Hajun.
